physicalNotes: Radius 0.0374 solar radii from González-Santamaría et al. (2021), A&A 656, A51, Table 8: log(L/Lsun) = 1.98 from the star's V magnitude at its Gaia EDR3 distance, and log(Teff) = 4.97; the paper prints no radius, and 0.0374 solar radii is the sphere that radiates that luminosity at that temperature (Stefan-Boltzmann law) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.12114): 26,019 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 93300 K from González-Santamaría et al. (2021), A&A 656, A51, Table 8: log(Teff) = 4.97, a temperature from the literature the paper compiles; spectral type DAO (https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.12114). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

sources.radialVelocity: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 843950873117830528 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 300,000 of its distance per century (https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia%20DR3%20843950873117830528)
